## Change and motivation

Describe the user-facing problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Verification

- [ ] `python tools/verify.py` passes, or an explicit explanation is provided.
- [ ] Regression tests cover the behavior, including failure paths.
- [ ] API changes and migration notes are documented.
- [ ] No credentials, real customer documents, provider response bodies or paid calls were added to offline tests.
- [ ] Any new provider capabilities are supported by evidence, not synthesized metadata.
